tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan lugs kyi rta mgrin nag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bgegs 'dul gnam lcags ral gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ra be/ gar gyi dbang phyug khrag 'thung dpal// phrin las drag po'i skur bzhengs pa// dus mtha'i sprin gyi mdog can la// btud nas sgrub thabs rjes gnang dgod// de la dang po sgrub thabs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod pas sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs 'gro spyi mthun lan gsum bya/ sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du rta mgrin bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ tshogs gsog ni/ rang skad cig gis rta mgrin du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal rta mgrin gyi dbu'i cha la sangs rgyas 'od dpag med bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na moḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya grī wa sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ h+ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / zhes lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig / ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ dngos gzhi la bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ oṃ swa bhā ba sogs brjod/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems hrīḥdamar nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar chad thams cad bsal nas rta mgrin gyi skur gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar thabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pas nad gdon sreg pa'i me'i phung po rab tu 'bar ba bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal mche ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs yod pa gtsigs shing*/ g.yon du rngam pa/ sma ra dang*/ smin ma dang*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar zhing 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ spyi bo nas rta mgo sngo ljang thon zhing rta skad kyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ klu rgyal rigs dkar pos dbur brgyan pa/ bram ze'i rigs dmar pos mgul pa brgyan pa/ rje'u rigs ser pos phyag gdub/ gdol pa'i rigs nag pos ga shal/ dmangs rigs ser pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal la sogs pa dpa' bo'i chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa khro gnyer shin tu gnyer zhing*/ rab tu 'jigs par byed pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing sku lus sbom la thung ba/ ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du hrīḥdamar nag tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ mchod pa gong ltar bya/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ tshogs zhing skabs ltar mchod/ hūm̐/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku /sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥ'i mthar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du bskor ba/ de dag las 'od zer pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par zhal nas 'thon te thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim par bsams la/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sarba tsit+ta ka la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan rbad rbud gtubs/ gṝh+ṇa rā dza ya rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces ci nus bzla/ thun mthar mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib bgegs dang log 'dren sogs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i nyer 'tshe thams cad zhi ba dang*/ myur du bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

ces 'dod don gsol/ thun 'jog pa na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bcom ldan rta mgrin 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / ces bsngo ba dang smon lam ci shes bya zhing bsnyen pa byed na 'bum phrag bzhi bzla bar bshad do// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/ chu gtsang gis bran la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// brjod med chos nyid don las ma g.yos kyang*// dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i don slad du// brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten rnal 'byor dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan steng na// ru dra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rngam brjid ngar dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lnga yi sku /sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes byon par bsam/ oṃ ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ hūm̐ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa i daṃ ba li ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi/ ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta la khā hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wid+ya āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo las// chos nyid mi 'gyur rta mchog rol pa'i sku/ gsung mchog rta skad 'tsher bas 'gro ba 'dul// dbyer med lhun grub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'gyur med rtogs pas sku mdog nag /shes rab ral gri 'phyar bas 'khor ba gcod// g.yon na me phung bsnams pas bdud khams sreg /'jigs byed drag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher// srid gsum sreg mdzad spyan gsum me phung 'phro// smin ma glog stong ma rig mun pa 'joms// gshin rje khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gtsigs// rnam thar brgyad ldan dpal gyi chas brgyad gsol// zhabs gnyis dor stabs bgrad pas bdud rnams 'joms// dbang chen khros pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gag med pad+ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyer med brtse ba'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam rdzas 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod// 'dod don gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin sogs nas/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bar snga ma ltar brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo ba dang bkra shis gang shes bya'o/

༈ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal ba byung gis byugs pa la me tog nag po'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i dbus su rta mgrin gyi sku dang dpal gtor dar gdugs mthing nag gis spras pa/ g.yas su sgrub thabs kyi glegs bam/ g.yon du seng ldeng gi phur pa/ rgyab tu rdo rje bkod/ chu gnyis nyer spyod dang 'bul gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa bsham/ yo byad gzhan spyi ltar 'du byas la/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gro bya/ skyabs sems nas brtsam bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas dang*/ tshom bu'i lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa/ mchod bstod/ gtor ma 'bul ba/ bzlas pa bya ba rnams bdag mdun gyi khyad par ma 'dzol bar grub rjes/ slob ma rnams khrus byas te gral du 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la 'dir sgrub sde chen po sde brgyad kyi nang tshan pad+ma gsung gi rigs dbang chen rta mchog rol pa la/ rta mgrin rigs lnga dang ye shes dang las kyi tshul du ston pa'i sgrub pa'i bka' srol mtha' yas pa byung ba las/ 'dir phrin las drag por khros pa rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can du grags pa/ 'di la'ang bka' gter las byon pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rim pa rgyas bsdus las tshogs kyi bye brag bcas mang du mchis pa las/ skabs su babs pa 'di ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang rnam dbyer med pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan la zhal gzigs nas byin gyis brlabs pas gdams ngag nye brgyud du byung ba'i rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs zhes yongs su grags shing*/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la nye bar 'tshe ba'i 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa spyi dang*/ nad gdon bgegs kyi rigs thams cad zhi zhing tshar gcod pa la mchog tu bsngags pa 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin pa lags pas/

khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams dgos pa yin pas/ slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu// de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la dbang bskur bstsal du gsol// lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rta mgrin la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum bzhugs par mos/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags bya/ slar yang thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid dpal rta mgrin gyi go 'phang ma 'thob kyi bar du/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin yi dam du 'dzin par 'tshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ des sngon 'gro'i chos rnams grub/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

oṃ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi sdig sgrib bag chags snang ba'i dngos po dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus mthing nag /de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor me tog re bzhag la/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las dpal rta mgrin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la mchod pa gong bzhin bya/ slob dpon gyis/

bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// dpal rta mgrin 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'di la dbang skur cig /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// rta mgrin go 'phang ma 'thob bar// yi dam lha ru mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ rta mgrin khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas mar la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyi ye shes pa bstim pa bya ba yin/ de ltar thim pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin nag po lcags kyi ral pa can sku mdog nag po/ ces pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ de nas sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du/ mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas dpal rta mgrin gyi sku khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste/ lus la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud dang nyon mongs pa thams cad tshar bcad nas/ rta mgrin gyi sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs te/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ bris sku spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dbang*// gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms par byed// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi skur byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas glegs bam khyed rang gi mgrin par gtugs te/ ngag la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud dang nyon mongs pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ rta mgrin gyi gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa ngag la zhugs te/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/

pusti spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi dbang*// gang gis bklags pa tsam gyis ni// dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par 'gyur// de ring sogs nas/ grī wa wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas bzlas lung gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la bstsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams rta mgrin du gsal ba'i snying ga'i dkyil du yi ge hrīḥdamar nag cig sgoms mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi rta mgrin la phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul/ rta mgrin gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba chu bur brdol ba bzhin thol thol byung*/ rta mgrin gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang der bsgoms pa'i zhal du zhugs/ hrīḥdamar nag gi mtha' skor du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha sogs rtsa sngags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du gzhug /de nas slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyis// zhes pa nas/ sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes pa'i bar brjod la me tog gtor/ des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ces sogs gong gi ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa khyed rang gi snying gar gtugs te mthar phyag g.yas su byin pas/ sems la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad nas/ rta mgrin gyi thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa sems la zhugs te/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rdo rje spyi borab zhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi dbang*// gang gis bcangs pa tsam gyis ni// bdud dang log lta 'joms par byed// de ring

sogs nas/ grī wa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob ces sogs ngo sprod 'don pa bsgyur/ phris kyi rjes gnang gi slad du mdun bskyed slob dpon dang bcas pas phur pa khyed rang gi phyag tu byin te/ byed las bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad nas/ rta mgrin gyi phrin las kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa khyed rnams kyi byed las la zhugs te/ phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba byin par mo sa/ seng ldeng phur bu bsgril zhing gtad la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las dbang*// gang gis bsgril ba tsam gyis ni// bdud dang dgra bgegs gsod par byed// de ring sogs nas/ grī wa karma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ des phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ byed las kyi bar chad zhi bar byas/ byed las bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin gyi phrin las su byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ 'dir rtsa gzhung du gtor ma'i byin brlab bshad pa ltar byed na/ gtor ma nyid sgrub thabs ltar dam tshig par bskyed/ tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstims nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab bar bya/ chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ skye 'gag gnyis su med pa'i sogs bstod pa sho lo ka lnga'i mthar/ rnal 'byor tshe yi bar chad zlog tu gsol// ces pas bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma'i dpal 'bar spar la byin rlabs bya bar gsungs pa 'di kho nas dbang rdzogs su'ang 'gyur bas rgyas par spro na de ltar bya/ rjes gnang dang sbrel ba'i tshe bka' bsgo tsam la gtor ma thogs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin nag po dngos su gsal ba'i dbu gtsug tu rtsa ba'i bla ma nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa'i mthar/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas yod par mos pa byas te/

de slob dpon gyis khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag nas bka' bsgos par mos pa mdzod/ mtshan mo yin na gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ nyin mo mi dgos/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung ba'i gnas// gtor ma'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sarba tsit+ta kā la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha rbad rbud gtubs/ shag ha nan rbad rbud gtubs/ gṝh+na rā dza ya rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ba liṃ ta badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das shrī ha ya grī wa/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zhang skyi tsha 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lo tsā ba/ zhang byang chub rin chen nas rim par byon pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ 'di rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'di rnams kyi nad dang gdon bgegs bar gcod thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod rnams dbang phyug la sogs pa legs pa'i yon thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gzhan yang las ngan sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma 'thob kyi bar du dpal rta mgrin rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la/ 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol// zhes phrin las bcol/ gtor ma rta mgrin du gsal ba de las bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin gyi sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa zhig mched de khyed rang gi spyi bor thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rjes/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtar rag maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba/ dge bsngo rnams spyi ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod 'bul/

yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ tsaka li la brtan bzhugs bya/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang smon lam ci shes gang rigs btab la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya bar gsungs so// stobs bcu'i shugs 'chang nyin byed gzis// bdud bgegs mun rum mthar bskrad nas// yang dag ye shes snang ba'i lam// byang chub bar du bder bgrod shog /ces pa 'di'ang rat+na gter gyi bang mdzod chen por dbyig gi bcud mchog yongs su rdzogs pa'i cha rkyen du pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis rtsa gzhung gi dgongs pa bcos med sor bzhag tu bkod pa dge legs 'phel// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// //
